subject: release-tooling/git-porcelain-protocol
statement: Treat Git porcelain output as protocol data. Never strip or lstrip the full stdout or a porcelain row before parsing its two-character XY status. Prefer `git status --porcelain=v1 -z` and parse NUL-delimited entries, including rename/copy records, before normalizing paths.
